description: This file defines the MessageException class within the Thunder::Core namespace, which is a custom exception class extending std::exception. It includes constructors, a destructor, and a method to retrieve the exception message. The file also includes licensing information and necessary includes.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends std::exception, providing message handling and optional system message inclusion.

methods.name: MessageException(const string& message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message.

methods.name: MessageException(const string& message, bool inclSysMsg)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and optionally appends system error message.

methods.description: Returns the exception message as a TCHAR string.
